description.value: Isabel Creek Store is a small grocery store in Daajing Giids (formerly Queen Charlotte City) on Haida Gwaii, a remote archipelago off BC's north coast accessible only by ferry or floatplane. The store carries organic products, making it a notable resupply point for cyclists who have made the journey to the islands. As one of the few grocery options in this small and isolated community, it is a practical stop for any touring cyclist exploring Haida Gwaii.
